question: Serves a 48-year-old woman in a pre-menopausal situation who practices regularly and is not a smoker. It presents a vertebral fracture in T11 considered fragility fracture. Point out the correct answer:

options.opa: It is not necessary to start anti-reabsorptive treatment by age and absence of other risk factors.
options.opb: I would recommend orienting your diet to strengthen the consumption of products rich in calcium and phosphorus.
options.opc: You should start treatment with an anti-reabsorptive agent associated with calcium and vitamin D supplements.
options.opd: No pharmacological treatment should be instituted until the results of lumbar and femoral bone densitometry are available.
